- Bigram model: only depends on the immediately preceding token
- Task: predict next token given current token
- Vocab size: 48, context length: 24
- Training data: 800 sequences of length 24 (so 800 × 24 = 19,200 token-level examples)
- Test data: 200 sequences of length 24
- Training budget: 1024 steps × 16 batch_size = 16,384 samples seen (about 85 epochs over training data)

- Parameters: token_embed (48×32=1536) + pos_embed (24×32=768) + 3 transformer layers + head (32×48=1536)
- Each transformer layer: self-attention (32×32=1024) + FFN (128×32=4096) + layerNorm
- Roughly: 1536 + 768 + 3×(1024 + 4096 + similar) + 1536 ≈ 200K params
- With d_model=32 and d_ff=128, this is relatively small

**Choice C:** Causal transformer with d_model=64, num_layers=2, d_ff=64, 4 heads
